gwt.given: An OrleansShardQueryDefinitions value has constructor-supplied grain type 'OrderGrain' and no QueryProcedure or Lazy<QueryStatement> for its clear role (only its read and write roles are supplied).
gwt.then: The access throws OrleansQueryNotProvidedException whose message is "The Orleans Grain “OrderGrain” does not have a query defined for its ClearQuery method." — naming ClearQuery specifically, not ReadQuery or WriteQuery, because the accessor property name is captured via [CallerMemberName].
